title: Cloud Pack
description: Step into a serene and modern Minecraft world with Cloud Pack, a carefully designed resource pack that transforms your game with clean visuals and subtle elegance.
body:
**Cloud Pack – Elevate Your Minecraft Experience to the Skies!**

Step into a serene and modern Minecraft world with **Cloud Pack**, a carefully designed resource pack that transforms your game with clean visuals and subtle elegance. This pack is perfect for players who want a fresh, minimalist aesthetic without sacrificing functionality.

### Features:
![In game menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab6911bbcb52753a150f8588cb092422fbc7824c.png)
* **Translucent GUI** – All your menus(in-game) and interface elements become transulent, giving you a sleek, airy look while keeping gameplay intuitive and readable.
   ![Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77b93218705c10821ada3a10f4373866db525ac1.png)
* **White Hearts** – Replace the standard red hearts with crisp, white ones for a modern and clean visual touch. Keep track of your health in style!
  ![Main Menu](https://i.ibb.co.com/NgsZvFV6/Screenshot-2025-11-27-222610.png)
* **Project Cloud Branding** – Swap out the default Java Edition branding with the soft, cloud-inspired **Project Cloud** logo for a unified theme throughout your game.
* **Light & Airy Design** – Every element of the interface has been thoughtfully tweaked to feel spacious and modern. From inventory menus to hotbar highlights, everything blends seamlessly.
* **Optimized for Clarity** – Enjoy a cleaner HUD that emphasizes gameplay without overwhelming visuals, perfect for building, exploration, or just admiring your world.
* **Immersive Minimalism** – Subtle design tweaks across fonts, icons, and interface elements give the game a cohesive, cloud-inspired look.

Bring the sky into your game! **Cloud Pack** is designed for players who love minimalism, clarity, and elegance, giving Minecraft a fresh feel while keeping the experience fully immersive. Perfect for both casual players and content creators who want a clean, modern aesthetic for screenshots and streams.
